design.pilot_reuse: same frozen r1 request keys only; never reuse across repeat IDs

evaluation.candidates: fold1 test target entities in test_links order
evaluation.query: fold1 test source entities in test_links order
evaluation.svd_fit: joint all 167 generated source + 167 generated target embeddings, separately within each run
evaluation.tie_rule: descending score, then ascending candidate entity ID (Unicode lexicographic)

postprocess: collapse Unicode whitespace; description only; no entity prefix, raw concat, repair, truncation or selection

alignments, explanations of the task, or facts copied from the demonstration entities.
